'increases excessively, the viruses...also increase, reducing their numbers'와 일치 → True

'utilizing their natural ability to infect and kill cells'와 일치
'while leaving healthy cells unharmed' 분사구문이어야 하므로 left가 아닌 leaving이어야 함
